== Summary ==
PC Errata 2013 slip of [[Run Luke, Run!]]: the printed slip (type bar, corrected game text and the title strip with “E”), meant to be placed over the original card. Image for [[Run Luke, Run! (PC Errata, 2013)]].

Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of January 1, 2013”; the PDF was made on 16 April 2013), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf] (SHA-1 3453cd4bee7d22faa58e3cfa492bea8021b2578c, the same file as the [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive copy] of 9 August 2016), PDF page 27; rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip; nothing else is edited.
